title: 第23章 初遇断头佛与白棺第24章 入谷
content_zh:
;;
即便大黄好不容易克服恐惧同意进山，经过这一番折腾。
此时也已经是日落黄昏。
李向东心里再按耐不住也得等一个晚上再说。
回来吃过晚饭后，李向东闲得无事，慢吞吞的踱到院子里李为民身边。
有一搭没一搭的说着傻了这两年村里发生的事。
李为民看到儿子主动找他聊天，放下烟枪话也多了起来。
东家长西家短，有什么说什么。
李向东心不在蔫的听着，等聊到差不多了话锋一转。
“爸，咱们村后面的那片深山老林中，有没有留下来些什么奇怪的传说啊？”
李为民眉头一皱：“奇怪传说？你打听这个干啥？”
李向东挠挠后脑勺哈哈一笑：“没干啥，这不是闲在家里没事干嘛。”
“打算写点东西寄给杂志社，看看能不能赚几个稿费。”
李为民一听儿子这是要搞文学上的大事，当即不敢耽误，绞劲脑汁想起来。
很快就想到几个。
李向东来劲了，竖起耳朵仔细认真的听着。
结果他说的不是些鬼打墙、鬼拍肩，就是山里下雨天有鬼影飘忽。
纠缠着滞留在山中的人，说找不到墓要人带的恐怖故事。
这些传说和长着尾巴的妖物一点也不搭边。
为此李向东不得不打断他，并且尝试着引导：

“就......没那种什么黄鼠狼讨封，妖物作祟之类的事吗？”
李为民露出憨厚一笑，放下烟枪：“傻儿子，咱们这里又不是北方，不拜灰白黄柳狐这些东西。”
李向东见打听不出什么，自顾自的回房间睡了。
第二天天不亮。
李向东趁着父母还在熟睡，在桌子上留下一张纸条，借口说去镇上见同学。
就悄悄带着大黄出发启程，背着大刀前往桃花村后的深山老林走去。
大黄重走老路，心中的阴霾始终无法驱散，整只狗显得闷闷不乐。
李向东见它这个样子，只得一路不停安慰它。
大概走了一个多小时，一人一狗走到人迹罕至之处，山中天气多变，忽然下起了雨。
李向东出来经验不够，没带雨伞。
只得偏离路线带着大黄来到一间从未见过的废弃寺庙躲雨。
很快。

Even though Dahuang finally overcame his fear and agreed to go into the mountains, after all this trouble.
It was already sunset at this time.
No matter how impatient Li Xiangdong was, he would have to wait one night before talking.
After coming back for dinner, Li Xiangdong had nothing to do and walked slowly to Li Weimin's side in the yard.
Some of them talked about what had happened in the village in the past two years.
When Li Weimin saw his son taking the initiative to chat with him, he put down his cigarette and started talking more.
The east is long and the west is short, so say whatever you want.
Li Xiangdong listened absentmindedly, and when the conversation was almost over, the conversation changed.
"Dad, are there any strange legends left in the deep mountains and old forests behind our village?"
Li Weimin frowned: "Strange legend? Why are you asking about this?"
Li Xiangdong scratched the back of his head and laughed: "I didn't do anything. This is not what I did when I was sitting around at home."
"I plan to write something and send it to the magazine to see if I can earn some royalties."
When Li Weimin heard that his son was going to engage in a major literary undertaking, he immediately did not dare to delay and racked his brains to think of it.
A few come to mind quickly.
Li Xiangdong became excited and listened carefully.
It turned out that he was either talking about ghosts hitting walls or tapping shoulders, or ghost shadows floating around in the mountains on rainy days.
He pesters people stranded in the mountains, telling scary stories about not being able to find the tomb and asking someone to take it away.
These legends have nothing to do with monsters with tails.
For this reason, Li Xiangdong had to interrupt him and try to guide:
"Just...there's no such thing as a weasel asking for a title or a monster causing trouble?"
Li Weimin smiled honestly and put down his pipe: "Silly son, we are not in the north here. We don't worship things like gray-white and yellow willow foxes."
Seeing that he couldn't find anything out, Li Xiangdong went back to his room and slept.
It was dark the next day.
Li Xiangdong left a note on the table while his parents were still asleep, using the excuse of going to town to meet his classmates.
He quietly took Dahuang and set off, carrying a sword on his back and heading for the deep mountains and old forests behind Taohua Village.
Dahuang went back to his old ways, the haze in his heart could not be dispelled, and the whole dog seemed depressed.
Seeing it like this, Li Xiangdong had no choice but to comfort it all the way.
After walking for about an hour, one person and one dog reached an inaccessible place. The weather in the mountains was changeable, and it suddenly started to rain.
Li Xiangdong was not experienced enough when he came out and did not bring an umbrella.
He had to deviate from the route and take Dahuang to an abandoned temple he had never seen before to take shelter from the rain.
soon.
